snippet.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 | Adventure Time Pack OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
The time to wash away the goo from Ooo is here!

The PowerWash Simulator 2 Adventure Time pack is OUT NOW!

Enjoy 5 new levels set in The Candy Kingdom, 10 new trophies and a Candy Cleaner outfit to use while cleaning the Land of Ooo!

Adventure Time will be coming to PowerWash Simulator 2 on April 9th for PC, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5, with Nintendo Switch 2 coming in the near future!

PowerWash Simulator 2 is available now! https://www.bit.ly/PWS2Steam

For more pressure washing goodness, subscribe to our channel! ⤵️
Follow our Twitter for daily satisfying content: https://bit.ly/TwitterPWS
Join the conversation on our Discord: https://discord.gg/powerwashsimulator
Follow us on TikTok for quick-spray socials: https://bit.ly/PWSTikTok
